title: tack.yaml
description: Configuration for tack, which generates dependency wiring in plain Go. Example: {prefix: New, providers: [internal/providers], targets: [{package: internal/app, interface: Service}]}

prefix.description: Prepended to the interface name to form the generated function name, so prefix New and interface Service give NewService. Without a prefix or a suffix the name is the interface name, which needs an output name or a different output package. Example: prefix: New

suffix.description: Appended to the interface name to form the generated function name, so suffix State and interface Redis give RedisState, and RedisStateTest for its test double. It combines with prefix: NewRedisState. Example: suffix: State

test.description: Also generate a test double next to each constructor. An output can override this. Example: test: true

providers.description: Packages searched for providers, relative to the module root. Shared by every output. Example: providers: [internal/providers, internal/infra]

targets.description: The interfaces to generate constructors for. Example: targets: [{package: internal/app, interface: Service}]

packagePath.description: A package directory relative to the module root. Absolute paths and paths that leave the module are rejected. Example: internal/app

target.description: An interface whose methods each name a dependency by return type. Example: {package: internal/app, interface: Service}

package.description: The package that holds the interface. Example: package: internal/app

interface.description: The interface name. Every method must take no arguments and return one value. Example: interface: Service

output.description: What to generate. Defaults to one output next to the interface. Give several to build more than one implementation. Example: output: [{name: NewProdState, package: internal/state/prod}, {name: NewStagingState, package: internal/state/staging}]
One generated constructor. Example: {name: NewProdState, package: internal/state/prod, provider: internal/providers/prod}

name.description: The constructor name. Defaults to the prefix, the interface name and the suffix, and it must not equal the interface name when the output is in the same package. Example: name: NewProdState

package.description: The package to write into. Defaults to the target's package, and the directory may not exist yet. Example: package: internal/state/prod

filename.description: The generated file name. Defaults to the lowercase interface name plus _gen.go. Example: filename: state_gen.go

provider.description: A package searched for providers before the global ones, to override a few dependencies and keep the rest shared. Example: provider: internal/providers/prod

test.description: Overrides the global test setting for this output. Example: test: false
